lines.text: Nebuchadnezzar, at ease in his palace, has a frightening dream and orders all the wise men of Babylon brought before him.
Daniel, whose name is Belteshazzar, comes in last, and the king says the spirit of the holy gods is in him.
In the dream, a watcher from heaven orders the tall tree cut down but its stump left in the ground with a band of silver.
Daniel, perplexed, tells the king that the great tree in the dream is the king himself.
Twelve months later, while the king boasts on his palace roof, a voice from heaven declares the kingdom gone, and he eats grass like a lion.
